resources.string: Diagnostic only. Import app-private vnc-config.json (schema 1: profileId, numericAddress, port, certificateSha256, durationSeconds 10–600). Only VeNCrypt X509Plain with an exact approved leaf pin is supported. Enter session-only credentials below. No reconnect or background service. Remote interoperability and desktop behavior require actual host qualification. Keyboard input uses physical keys; native fields retain their Android editing and IME behavior.
Remote VNC framebuffer. Focus here for physical keyboard and absolute pointer input.
Credentials must be nonempty canonical UTF-8 without NUL (username ≤256 bytes, password ≤1024 bytes).
